scope: Delivery playbooks, round 3 (epic cr-p3em): the critic's round-2 REVISE findings on Shipping and Babysit, fixed under the coordinator's rulings. Visual parity and the router lines are unchanged. No report and no upstream trait rows (README 4a's playbook exemption).
method: Critic review of round 2026-11-20-delivery-playbooks-r2 (3 blockers in Shipping, 4 majors, 1 minor) and the coordinator's rulings, including a lean addendum: tree equality replaces patch-id reuse, a direct merge mutation pinned to the head, an isolated child move, a shared stack bead claim, a bounded wake. Four round-2 trait definitions no playbook now holds were removed before commit; their replacements are new IDs.

subject: doc:.claude/skills/mvp-mode/playbooks/shipping.md
why: Critic-107 round 2 fixes (B1-B3, M10). Verdict reuse moves from patch-id to tree equality (verdict-reuse-on-tree replaces verdict-reuse-on-patch-and-base-tree): an identical tree is identical code, so the owner's intent of reusing a verdict across a parent's squash merge is kept, since the moved child's tree is unchanged exactly when nothing else landed; patch-id comparison is gone. shipping#1 takes the stack-wide claim Babysit uses (stack-wide-claim) and loads beads before the first bead write. shipping#3's verdict is bound to the tree it ran on (independent-user-run-verdict replaces per-pr-user-run-verdict), keyed verdict <pr>@<tree sha> and posted by the coordinator on the reviewer's behalf with its identity attached. shipping#4 confirms both keyed posts exist before every merge, fresh or reused (verdict-receipts-before-merge replaces verdict-posts-confirmed), merges through the mergePullRequest mutation with expectedHeadOid (direct-merge-mutation-at-verified-head replaces direct-merge-at-verified-head; a required queue stops the run), reads back MERGED on trunk with the base-edit window as a stated limit, and moves the child in a detached worktree at the snapshot head with a lease on the full ref.

subject: doc:.claude/skills/mvp-mode/playbooks/babysit.md
why: Critic-107 round 2 fixes (M2, M3, M5, M6). babysit#1: one wake attempt is one push wave or one wait cycle, limit 20 unless the request sets one, and every wait is bounded by the card's time left, going to closeout when it runs out. babysit#2: the claim is on the nearest bead the stack's open pull requests share, kept as the frontier advances. babysit#3: the required-check set is read from trunk's rules and protection (a proven empty set passes, a missing result is unknown), and a frontier in a merge queue takes a new In queue exit. The reply gains a Threads answered exit for threads-only. Traits unchanged.
